full_judgment:
This Rule is directed against the judgment and decree dated 10-11-92 passed by the District Judge, Narayanganj in Title Appeal No. 60 of 1990 affirming the judgment and decree dated 30-4-90 passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, Narayanganj in Title Suit No. 91 of 1989 decreeing the suit. 

 4. At the trial the plaintiff examined himself as his only witness while the contesting defendant examined 2 witnesses in support of their case. After hearing the patties, the learned Assistant, Judge by his impugned judgment dated 30-4-90 decreed the suit, on consideration of the evidence on record, with the findings that the impugned order dated 11-9-89 as contained in Memo No. 63 of 1989 of defendant No. 4 dismissing the plaintiff from the 'post of the Assistant Teacher of Narayanganj High School is illegal, without jurisdiction and the same is not binding upon the plaintiff and he is still an Assistant Teacher of Narayanganj High School. Against the aforesaid judgment and decree the contesting defendants took an appeal before the District Judge, Narayanganj being Title Appeal No. 60 of 1990, and the learned District Judge by his impugned judgment dated 10-11-89 dismissed the appeal on contest and affirmed the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court decreeing the suit It is against the said judgment and decree the defendant petitioners moved the Court and obtained this present Rule. 

 14. In the result, the Rule is discharged with costs. The impugned judgment and decree passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Narayanganj in Title Suit No. 91 of 1989 decreeing the suit, which have subsequently been affirmed by the District Judge, Narayanganj in Title Appeal No. 60 of 1990, are maintained.
